minor.issue: HEAD returns 405 Method Not Allowed even though CORS Allow-Methods advertises HEAD; browsers don't strictly need it (Range GET works, 206 served), but the mismatch is worth cleaning up.

ui_bugs.issue: The uploaded video file /api/media/biraajo/gallery/cd7d617db6534131b7f07fa2eecd0b18.mp4 is served correctly (200/206, video/mp4, 7.5MB, Range OK) but Chrome/Chromium FFmpeg demuxer refuses it: v.error.code=4, message='PipelineStatus::DEMUXER_ERROR_NO_SUPPORTED_STREAMS: FFmpegDemuxer: no supported streams'. All five <video> tags (wtwe-poster-image, homepage-chapter-card-03, archive-chapter-03, menu-card-wtwe, supper-card-wtwe) therefore render as empty/black boxes with videoWidth=0, readyState=0, networkState=3 (NO_SOURCE). Direct navigation to the URL in a fresh tab reproduces the same error, so the fault is in the file bitstream, NOT the front-end code, MIME type, CORS, or React logic. Container reports ftyp=isom/iso2/avc1/mp41 and avcC declares H.264 High@L4.0, so it likely has a non-standard/unsupported color/HDR sample-entry or an incompatible audio stream that FFmpeg's browser build refuses. FIX: re-encode/transcode the source video to baseline browser-safe H.264 (profile main or high, 8-bit yuv420p, no HDR/BT.2020) + AAC-LC audio in an MP4 with faststart, then re-upload and re-run migration wtwe_hero_video_cover_v1. Since ffmpeg is not installed in this container, main agent should either install ffmpeg (apt-get install ffmpeg) and transcode, or ask the user to re-export a browser-compatible mp4 (e.g. HandBrake 'Web Optimized' preset).

rca of the issue: RCA (WTWE video cover empty boxes): 1) File /app/backend/uploads/... (served at /api/media/biraajo/gallery/cd7d617db6534131b7f07fa2eecd0b18.mp4) advertises ftyp brand isom/iso2/avc1/mp41 with an avcC declaring H.264 High profile @ Level 4.0 and an mp4a audio track. 2) Cloudflare/starlette serve it correctly with content-type=video/mp4, accept-ranges=bytes, 200 on full GET, 206 on Range GET; content-length=7790640 matches on-disk size. 3) Chrome's HTMLMediaElement fires an 'error' event with code=4 and message 'PipelineStatus::DEMUXER_ERROR_NO_SUPPORTED_STREAMS: FFmpegDemuxer: no supported streams'. Reproducing by navigating directly to the raw mp4 URL yields the same error. 4) Therefore the fault is in the bitstream / sample-entry (e.g. unusual color primaries, 10-bit yuv, HDR sidecar, or a non-web-safe audio codec) — the container header lies about what is inside, or the profile combination is one Chrome's shipped FFmpeg rejects. Reproduction: open https://premium-chef-demo.preview.emergentagent.com/api/media/biraajo/gallery/cd7d617db6534131b7f07fa2eecd0b18.mp4 in Chrome → controls appear, no playback, DevTools console/Media panel shows the demuxer error. Mitigation: transcode with ffmpeg -i input.mp4 -c:v libx264 -profile:v high -pix_fmt yuv420p -crf 23 -preset veryfast -c:a aac -movflags +faststart output.mp4 (or use HandBrake 'Web Optimized'); replace the uploaded file (same URL) or upload new + PATCH site-content wtwe.hero.image and update WTWE_COVER in /app/frontend/src/lib/chapters.js.
